name: Speech-Filtered Bubble Ray
summary: A multimodal target acquisition technique for large display walls that combines Bubble Ray pointing with speech-based filtering to reduce the number of possible targets.
howItWorks: The user points toward a group of possible targets with a bubble ray and then speaks a filtering term, such as a target property or category. The system uses the speech input to reduce the candidate set and make the intended target easier to acquire.
advantages: Selecting targets on large display walls when many objects are visible and the user can use speech to narrow the candidate set.
limitations: The technique depends on reliable speech recognition and on targets having useful verbal properties or labels for filtering. It may be less suitable in noisy environments or when speech input is socially inappropriate.
